name: Sheila Goins
bio:
Sheila Goins brings a decade of real estate experience and a background in education to the Gaspard & Co Real Estate family. Before entering real estate, she spent more than 25 years serving her community as an educator and principal—a foundation that adds a personal perspective to helping people through important decisions.

Her real estate experience includes homes, townhouses, multifamily properties, and residential land. She actively serves the Greater Baton Rouge Area and surrounding communities, with work that includes Baton Rouge, Livingston, Denham Springs, Walker, and Zachary.

Sheila holds the At Home With Diversity® (AHWD) certification and was recognized in Acadiana Profile’s 2021 Top Real Estate Professionals list.

At Gaspard & Co, Sheila continues her career alongside familiar colleagues in an office that feels like family. Her background in education and real estate brings together years of community service and practical property experience as she helps clients prepare for their next chapter.

reviews.quote: Ms.Sheila was a joy to work with! She is knowledgeable and goes above and beyond to help her clients in any way she can. I would/do recommend her to anyone looking for a realtor. She is not one of those that treats you like any other client, she makes you feel like family and you can tell she loves what she does. Thanks for all your help Ms.Sheila!
